caption:
No hardship reaches you without His permission

Whatever is weighing on you today did not slip past Allah. And He promises to guide the heart of whoever believes in Him.

Surah At-Taghaabun 64:11

Read it twice, then tell Allah what you are carrying

#trustinallah #tawakkul #quranreels #hardtimes

Recitation: Yasser Al-Dosari
alt_text: No calamity befalls except with Allah’s permission. Whoever believes in Allah, He will guide his heart. And Allah is All-Knowing of everything (Surah At-Taghaabun 64:11)
